{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prediction (out of sample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T23:08:31.479977Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T23:08:31.479757Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T23:08:32.438441Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T23:08:32.437710Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T23:08:32.444729Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T23:08:32.440919Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.586689Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.585722Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rc(\"figure\", figsize=(16, 8))\n",
    "plt.rc(\"font\", size=14)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Artificial data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.589198Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.588799Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.595876Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.594467Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "sig = 0.25\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, np.sin(x1), (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "beta = [5.0, 0.5, 0.5, -0.02]\n",
    "y_true = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y = y_true + sig * np.random.normal(size=nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.598189Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.597953Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.615607Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.614934Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   R-squared:                       0.987\n",
      "Model:                            OLS   Adj. R-squared:                  0.986\n",
      "Method:                 Least Squares   F-statistic:                     1162.\n",
      "Date:                Wed, 19 Aug 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           2.37e-43\n",
      "Time:                        23:08:35   Log-Likelihood:                 5.0607\n",
      "No. Observations:                  50   AIC:                            -2.121\n",
      "Df Residuals:                      46   BIC:                             5.527\n",
      "Df Model:                           3                                         \n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          t      P>|t|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const          4.8159      0.078     61.974      0.000       4.659       4.972\n",
      "x1             0.5278      0.012     44.039      0.000       0.504       0.552\n",
      "x2             0.5634      0.047     11.959      0.000       0.469       0.658\n",
      "x3            -0.0221      0.001    -20.976      0.000      -0.024      -0.020\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Omnibus:                        0.556   Durbin-Watson:                   1.902\n",
      "Prob(Omnibus):                  0.757   Jarque-Bera (JB):                0.353\n",
      "Skew:                          -0.205   Prob(JB):                        0.838\n",
      "Kurtosis:                       2.960   Cond. No.                         221.\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "Notes:\n",
      "[1] Standard Errors assume that the covariance matrix of the errors is correctly specified.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "olsmod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "olsres = olsmod.fit()\n",
    "print(olsres.summary())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In-sample prediction"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.620907Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.620618Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.634007Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.633324Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 4.26410953  4.78957212  5.27093879  5.67750436  5.98964498  6.20204228\n",
      "  6.32455719  6.38060976  6.40333138  6.43012134  6.49650225  6.63028377\n",
      "  6.84699355  7.14732612  7.51702874  7.9292431   8.34891807  8.73856848\n",
      "  9.06443387  9.3020252   9.44014832  9.48274319  9.44823651  9.36651427\n",
      "  9.27401159  9.20772651  9.19914134  9.26905018  9.4241425   9.65590414\n",
      "  9.94201609 10.25002147 10.54265813 10.78398066 10.94526617 11.00973335\n",
      " 10.97529959 10.85492319 10.67447428 10.46848449 10.27447346 10.1267845\n",
      " 10.05094206 10.05945815 10.14977663 10.30469321 10.49518205 10.68516459\n",
      " 10.83743722 10.91978369]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ypred = olsres.predict(X)\n",
    "print(ypred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create a new sample of explanatory variables Xnew, predict and plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.637903Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.636912Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.649383Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.648724Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[10.89434316 10.72036238 10.41993607 10.04341524  9.65707955  9.3269097\n",
      "  9.10243311  9.00459784  9.02064375  9.10722671]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x1n = np.linspace(20.5, 25, 10)\n",
    "Xnew = np.column_stack((x1n, np.sin(x1n), (x1n - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "Xnew = sm.add_constant(Xnew)\n",
    "ynewpred = olsres.predict(Xnew)  # predict out of sample\n",
    "print(ynewpred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot comparison"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.652199Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T23:08:35.651876Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T23:08:36.253937Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T23:08:36.248566Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x7f077573b620>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1600x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y, \"o\", label=\"Data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(np.hstack((x1, x1n)), np.hstack((ypred, ynewpred)), \"r\", label=\"OLS prediction\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Predicting with Formulas"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Using formulas can make both estimation and prediction a lot easier"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T23:08:36.256347Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T23:08:36.256078Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T23:08:36.279112Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T23:08:36.277596Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
    "\n",
    "data = {\"x1\": x1, \"y\": y}\n",
    "\n",
    "res = ols(\"y ~ x1 + np.sin(x1) + I((x1-5)**2)\", data=data).fit()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We use the `I` to indicate use of the Identity transform. Ie., we do not want any expansion magic from using `**2`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T23:08:36.281967Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T23:08:36.281736Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T23:08:36.295441Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T23:08:36.294868Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intercept           4.815901\n",
       "x1                  0.527782\n",
       "np.sin(x1)          0.563407\n",
       "I((x1 - 5) ** 2)   -0.022072\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.params"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we only have to pass the single variable and we get the transformed right-hand side variables automatically"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T23:08:36.299999Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T23:08:36.299767Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T23:08:36.312993Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T23:08:36.312271Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "0    10.894343\n",
       "1    10.720362\n",
       "2    10.419936\n",
       "3    10.043415\n",
       "4     9.657080\n",
       "5     9.326910\n",
       "6     9.102433\n",
       "7     9.004598\n",
       "8     9.020644\n",
       "9     9.107227\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.predict(exog=dict(x1=x1n))"
   ]
  }
 ],
